missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Тревога' is feminine nominative as the subject. 'Слышна' is the short-form adjective agreeing in the feminine, and 'в голосе' is the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Тревогу' is the feminine accusative object of 'чувствую'. 'Сильную' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В тревоге' uses the prepositional ending after 'в' to describe a state. 'Постоянной' agrees in the feminine prepositional.

missions.phrase: У меня нет причин для тревоги.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Для тревоги' takes the genitive after 'для' to mean grounds for anxiety. 'Причин' is the genitive plural object of 'нет'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'От тревоги' takes the genitive after 'от' to mean ridding oneself of anxiety. The verb 'избавился' governs this construction.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В тревогу' uses the accusative after 'в' to show being thrown into anxiety. 'Всех' is the accusative object, 'новость' the subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Благодаря тревоге' uses the dative after 'благодаря' to mean because of the anxiety. The clause explains his caution.

missions.phrase: Она смотрела на меня с тревогой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'С тревогой' uses the instrumental after 'с' to mean with anxiety. The phrase describes the manner of her gaze.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Тревоги' is the nominative plural subject of 'мучают'. 'Ночные' agrees, and 'меня' is the accusative object being tormented.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Тревог' is the genitive plural required after 'столько'. The exclamation stresses how many worries he has.
